claims.statement: For a known k-mode pure-death CTMC with distinct positive decay rates and nonzero mode amplitudes, terminal Bernoulli discrimination after delay tau satisfies D(tau)-D0 = sum_r A_r exp(-delta_r tau), where A_r = p_r C_r.
assumptions: State space {0,...,k}; state 0 absorbing; state r transitions only to 0 at rate delta_r
Initial occupancy of mode r is p_r
At a fixed delay, test input u emits a Bernoulli output with state-specific probability theta_{u,r}
The reported observation is the pair of terminal success probabilities or their discrimination difference, not the full hidden path
claims.novelty_boundary: CTMC occupancy identity; application of standard exponential-sum representation. No priority claim.

costs.data: one scalar discrimination mean per delay plus reset baseline

claims.falsifier: A resolved output curve under this terminal Bernoulli interface that cannot be represented as a sum of at most k real decaying exponentials, after the reset baseline is removed.
claims.next_gate: Extend or refute for general transient generators and richer emission interfaces.

claims.statement: Under distinct rates and nonzero amplitudes, 2k equally spaced exact discrimination means identify the unordered pairs (A_r,delta_r); fewer than 2k scalar means cannot generically identify the 2k curve parameters.
assumptions: Exact means and equally spaced known delays
Reset baseline D0 supplied or separately measured
claims.novelty_boundary: Prony/Hankel reconstruction is classical; this is a self-contained specialization and cost statement for the stated CTMC observation interface.

costs.computation: O(k^3) arithmetic and O(k^2) storage; precision depends on conditioning

claims.falsifier: For exact data generated within the assumptions, the Hankel pencil does not return the true decay factors and Vandermonde amplitudes.
claims.next_gate: Prove quantitative noise stability under explicit lower bounds on amplitude and pairwise rate separation.

claims.statement: Delay-only terminal discrimination observations identify p_r and C_r only through A_r=p_r C_r, even with a continuum of exact delays; a labeled occupancy readout or supplied known p_r values break this equivalence.
assumptions: The observation interface contains terminal challenge probabilities only
Parameters lie in the interior of the valid Bernoulli and initial-distribution constraints
claims.novelty_boundary: Does not imply nonidentifiability from full CTMC path or richer outputs; scope is terminal probability summaries.

costs.extra_observable: mode label/occupancy probabilities from independent initialized trials, or an independently calibrated p vector
costs.label_bits: at most ceil(log2(k+1)) per categorical state label

claims.falsifier: An estimator using only the specified terminal-probability curve that uniquely recovers p_r and C_r on an open parameter set.
claims.next_gate: Compare terminal-only summaries with full event-time likelihoods and quantify when event timing removes product confounding.

overall_status: conditional mathematical result; external correctness review and literature-priority audit not performed
